blog.title: HOW I MADE NOSCOPE VOL. 9 (a guide) (3 min read)
blog.body: step 1. record. (my cousins capture card. weekends only. plan ur life around the weekend.) step 2. watch EVERYTHING. 9 hrs of footage becomes 11 min. most of it is me falling or looking at a wall. step 3. pick the song first. the song is the boss. u edit to the drum hit. a cut on the drum hit is a gunshot. step 4. one crossfade. ONE. step 5. slow-mo goes ON the kill, not before it. before it is just waiting. step 6. credit everybody. if josh got the kill, josh gets the kill. i dont care if its my montage. thats the only rule. step 7. put the best thing at 4:12. step 8. show it to someone who loves u. they dont have to get it. they just have to sit there with pretzels.

blog.title: THE FALL (4:12) (what really happened) (i can say it now)
blog.body: ok everyone asks. the fall at 4:12 wasnt a trick. i was on lockout trying to jump from the top of one tower to the other (its been done, i saw it on a forum). i ran, i jumped, and the game was like 'no.' i fell for 4 full seconds. in the clip u can hear me say 'oh' and then 'ohhhh' and then nothing. i was going to cut it. i was. then my dad walked in and saw it on the tv and laughed so hard he had to sit on the stairs. best laugh ive ever heard from him. so i put it at 4:12 and im leaving it there until im 40. its the only honest clip in vol. 9. everything else is edited. that one is just me.

blog.title: SPONSOR LETTER (draft 6) (not sent) (sent)
blog.body: To Whom It May Concern, My name is Hunter. I am 15. I make montages (9 so far). I would like to represent your brand in the Halo 2 community. I do not currently have followers, but I have a dad who watches every one and a kid named Kyle who watched one 6 times. My k/d is not what you would call competitive, but I would like to point out that k/d is a team stat. I edit. I credit. I show up. If you send me a free shirt I will wear it in every montage. If you send me a controller I will wear that too. Sincerely, Hunter (xX_NoScope_Xx). P.S. My mom says to add 'thank you for your time.' Thank you for your time. P.P.S. She also says to remove 'k/d is a team stat.' I did not.
